notes: Corrected הִשְׁכִּים לָקוּם: under rule 56's auxiliary-verb sentence (הִרְבָּה לַעֲשׂוֹת → wrought much), שָׁכַם takes the adverb 'early' and the infinitive קוּם takes the lexical predicate 'was risen'; the לְ remains unrepresented since the ASV writes no word for it. The accepted reading left a written lexical verb with nothing while one morpheme held the whole phrase.
